AADHYA.name: Aadhya Power & Infra Private Limited
AADHYA.about: Aadhya Power & Infra Private Limited is a special-purpose vehicle incorporated in December 2025 in Telangana, for the sole purpose of developing, owning, and operating an 8-site, 15 MW (AC) / 18 MW (DC) solar PV portfolio under Component A of the PM-KUSUM scheme. All 8 sites are spread across 6 districts of Telangana, each evacuating into a separate 33/11 kV distribution substation. All 8 sites are contracted under 25-year power purchase agreements with the Telangana distribution utilities TGSPDCL (3 sites) and TGNPDCL (5 sites) — at a flat tariff of Rs 3.13/kWh

AESPL.name: Aapaavani Environmental Solutions Private Limited
AESPL.about: AESPL is a Dakshina Kannada (Karnataka) based EPC company that designs, builds and commissions Sewage Treatment Plants (STPs), (STPs), Effluent Treatment Plants (ETPs) and Water Treatment Plants (WTPs) for industrial and institutional clients across India

BIOFUEL.name: Biofuelcircle Private Limited
BIOFUEL.about: Pune-based digital marketplace for biomass and biofuel supply chain management, incorporated in June 2020. BiofuelCircle operates through three integrated verticals. First, its E-Marketplace (Platform Business), contributing approximately 60-65% of revenue, operates as a digital B2B marketplace; Biomass Bank (Aggregation & Supply), contributing 30-35% of revenue where it aggregates biomass during harvest seasons through its network of 75+ Biomass Banks; Envira (Processing & Manufacturing) vertical, currently ~5% of revenue, focuses on value-added products — branded biomass briquettes and pellets manufactured through owned facilities

ENERPARC.name: Enerparc Energy Pvt. Ltd.
ENERPARC.about: EEPL is the Indian subsidiary of ENERPARC AG, Germany, a globally established renewable energy company with over 4.7 GW of solar capacity developed across 27 countries. Operating in India since 2012, EEPL has developed approximately 750 MWp of solar projects, of which around 160 MWp is owned and operated through its SPVs while the balance has been executed under the EPC model for third-party customers

HEAVEN.name: Heaven Green Energy Limited
HEAVEN.about: Solar EPC and solar products distribution company based out of Surat, Gujarat. It operates under the brand Heaven Solar. Empanelled with GEDA, GUVNL, Discom. Company also does Solar Module Trading and Distribution, with a presence across 20+ countries and 22+ channel partners

HITECH.name: Hi Tech Agro Energy Private Limited

IDENTIFYPLUS.name: Identifyplus Delivery Services Private Limited
IDENTIFYPLUS.about: Identifyplus Delivery Services Private Limited (IDSPL), is engaged in the business of providing support services to organizations. IDSPL was incorporated in 2016 and has its registered office located in Haryana

INDUSASSIST.name: Indusassist
INDUSASSIST.about: Indusassist Private Limited (IPL) is engaged in the business of providing renewable energy solutions. The company provides consultancy, liaisoning, and engineering services for various sectors like the power sector, IT industry, data centers, commercial, institutional, recreational, high-rise residential, retail, townships, and manufacturing facilities

INFRAMAT.name: Inframat Alloys Private Limited
INFRAMAT.about: Inframat Alloys Private Limited (IAPL), is engaged in the business of manufacturing galvanized pipes. The company has its manufacturing unit located in Hosur, Tamil Nadu. Its products include fence pipes, galvanized Pipe, structural steel pipes, ERW steel tubes, fence tubes, and more

INVERGY.name: Invergy India Private Limited
INVERGY.about: GP Eco Solutions India Limited (GESIL), is engaged in the business of manufacturing solar plants and trading of electrical goods and solar plants and their ancillary products

KNY.name: Kny Industries Private Limited
KNY.about: KNY Projects Private limited is a company based out of Delhi and has been in operations since last 22 years. Mr. Ravi Yadav & Mrs. Poonam Yadav are promotors. With over 20 years of expertise in Architectural Design, Engineering Design, Turnkey Construction and EPC, KNY Group has become a trusted name in India’s infrastructure and energy sectors

MIRGREEN.name: Mir Green Energy
MIRGREEN.about: MIR SUNCOL BIPV PRIVATE LIMITED is a new strategic joint venture between MIR Solution S.R.L. and SunCol S.R.L., to set up a cutting-edge Building-Integrated Photovoltaics (BIPV) manufacturing facility with an annual production capacity of 1.5 million m/sq.. The facility, located within a Special Economic Zone in India

NVNRTEL.name: Nvnr Telangana Kusum Power Plant Private Limited
NVNRTEL.about: A special-purpose vehicle of the NVNR group, formed to build and operate eleven ground-mounted solar plants of 2 MW (AC) each — 22 MW (AC) / 26.4 MW (DC) in aggregate —under Component A of the PM-KUSUM scheme. The plants are spread across six districts of Telangana, and each evacuates into a separate 33/11 kV distribution substation. All eleven sites are contracted under 25-year power purchase agreements with the Telangana distribution utilities (TGSPDCL for nine sites and TGNPDCL for two) at a flat tariff of Rs 3.13/kWh

PLASKON.name: Plaskon Plastics Eco Circular Private Limited

PRIMEVEAL.name: Primeveal Renewables
PRIMEVEAL.about: Primeval Renewable Projects Private Limited (PRPPL), as per annual filings, is engaged in the business of generation of electricity using solar power

PURPLESOIL.name: Purple Soil Technology Ventures Private Limited
PURPLESOIL.about: Purple Soil Technology Ventures Private Limited (PSTVPL) is a telecommunication infrastructure provider. PSTVPL is engaged in the installation and commissioning of poles, towers, and Optical Fibre Cable (OFC) Systems in India

RIDEV.name: Anv Web Ventures Private Limited
RIDEV.about: RidEV is Hyderabad-headquartered EV-as-a-Service company. It purchases electric two-wheelers from established OEMs — Ather, TVS, BGauss and Ampere — and deploys them under two complementary leasing channels: a B2C model in which individual gig workers (Delhivery, Swiggy, Bigbasket, Whizzy delivery partners) lease scooters on a weekly basis through the RidEV mobile app, and a B2B model in which the company supplies vehicles in bulk to logistics

SHIPWAVES.name: Shipwaves Online Limited
SHIPWAVES.about: Shipwaves Online Limited (SOL) is engaged in the business of providing digital freight forwarding platform. It offers Shipwaves SCM Platform 2.0, FCL freight forwarding , LCL freight forwarding, Real time container tracking and air freight services

SIXTHENERGY.name: 6th Energy Technology
SIXTHENERGY.notes: Lens (mitiga listed as mitigation lead); review

SURYAINTL.name: Surya International Enterprise Limited
SURYAINTL.about: Surya International Enterprise Limited is the flagship company of the Group Surya ecosystem, dedicated to delivering green energy and clean tech solutions. With over 14 years of experience, the group has developed strong expertise in EPC of solar power projects, solar-based water treatment, and micro-irrigation. It is also expanding into green hydrogen to promote sustainable and efficient resource utilization. Products include solar modules, inverters, EV chargers, PVC pipes, lithium-ion batteries, and other electronic components under OEM arrangements

TSUYO.name: Tsuyo Manufacturing Private Limited
TSUYO.about: Tsuyo Manufacturing Private Limited (TMPL) is engaged in the business of manufacturing EV motors and controllers. It offers EV (Electric Vehicles) components, including electric motors, drives, converters, bikes, trucks, gearboxes, axles, e-rickshaw, e-auto, three-wheeler (low speed), three-wheelers (high speed), and four-wheelers

ZEON.name: Zeon Charging
ZEON.about: Co. owns and operates public DC fast-charging stations — typically sited beside highway restaurants, hotels, malls and cinemas — and sells electricity to EV owners at a retail tariff. . As of FY26 it runs 267 company-owned DC fast chargers (~14.9 MW) across roughly 160 DC stations and 64 AC stations, with the network concentrated in Tamil Nadu and extending into Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Maharashtra

rejected on financial profile - EBITDA loss making in FY 26

Significant levels of intangible assets are being capitalised year-on-year, with a substantial portion of the debt raised appearing to fund these assets.
Certain expense heads capitalised within intangible assets would, if charged to the P&L, result in EBITDA losses at the operating level.
The company currently lacks a visible executable order book and is presently servicing only O&M revenues of ~Rs. 30 lakhs.
The projected growth trajectory appears highly aggressive and is not supported by a commensurate order pipeline. The company is projecting revenue growth from ~Rs. 3 crore in FY25 to ~Rs. 80 crore over the near term.
Certain transactions with the quasi-equity provider (Quest) appear to fall outside the ordinary course of business and require further clarity.
Promoter unsecured loans of ~Rs. 1.92 crore do not fully reconcile with the corresponding bank statement flows. Management has clarified that certain purchases were directly funded through the promoters’ personal accounts; however, the accounting treatment and reconciliation remain unclear
